title: Momentum dock — 1:1 prep for Rajiv (sprint checkpoint)
content:
Meeting details:
- Who: Rajiv Patel (report) — Senior SW Engineer, batching + KV cache work
- When: 2027-04-04 10:30am (30m)
- Context: mid-sprint checkpoint, Rajiv just came off a week of on-call and shipped the initial batching refactor branch into staging. Want to align on blockers, career growth signals, and what to prioritize for the rest of sprint.

Objectives (my goals for this 1:1):
1) Surface any latent blockers that would derail the refactor rollout (infra, perf regressions, rollout policy).
2) Give concrete coaching on stakeholder communication and postmortem writeup cadence after on-call incident.
3) Confirm next steps for Rajiv's IC growth plan (mentorship, visibility, lead on rollout).

Quick signals / things I noticed since last 1:1:
- PR 782 merged to staging but perf tests show 6% tail latency increase for 8k token sequences on p4d-8x. Potential regression in KV cache warm-path (see GH perf run).
- Rajiv handled the on-call page at 02:10am last Friday; blameless summary exists but no owner on action item to update runbook.
- Rajiv picked up two mentoring sessions with junior engs (positive).
- He flagged that cross-team dependence (infra team) is slow to respond on the new kernel config change (ticket RINF-1245).

Agenda (30m):
- 0-3m: quick personal check-in (sleep / recharge after on-call)
- 3-10m: status on batching rollout + what the perf numbers actually mean (ask for a short explanation)
- 10-18m: blockers deep-dive (infra ticket status, who to escalate to, timeline)
- 18-25m: career / growth touch — talk about taking lead on the rollout and visibility plan
- 25-30m: review action items + confirm follow-ups

Key questions I want to ask Rajiv (short prompts):
- Walk me through the perf numbers you saw in staging. Where do you suspect the regression is coming from?
- Which tests are most important to get stable before we push to prod? Any A/B gating suggestions?
- On the infra ticket (RINF-1245), who is the primary contact on their side? Have you tried pairing with them?
- Do you want to own the runbook update post-incident? If not, who should be owner?
- How are you feeling about taking a lead-facing role for this rollout? What support do you need?

Proposed coaching / talking points (notes to self):
- Encourage Rajiv to translate perf numbers into a one-paragraph impact statement for stakeholders (SRE, product).
- Suggest a brief canary plan: 10% traffic for 24h with latency SLO alarms and auto-fallback, and a rollback playbook. Offer to help draft the canary email to stakeholders.
- Remind to assign and close the runbook action item; reinforce blameless framing. Offer to block time to pair on the first iteration.
- Growth: propose a short internal demo to Eng All Hands showing the batching wins & tradeoffs — good visibility for IC growth.

Potential blockers and my proposed mitigations (to present):
- Infra delay on kernel config change: propose to escalate via Priya (infra lead) and open a parallel short-lived rollback toggle so we can decouple infra dependency from rollout schedule.
- Perf regression uncertainty: run a focused microbench for KV warm-path with controlled inputs; ask SRE to allocate a test node with same hw profile.
- Stakeholder buy-in: prepare a one-pager with clear rollback criteria and incident contact list.

Action items (capture immediately; owner / due):
- AI-1: Rajiv to summarize perf delta in <=200 words and attach the perf-dashboard link. Due: 2027-04-05. (owner: Rajiv)
- AI-2: Keiko to sync with Priya (infra lead) about RINF-1245 and propose a timeline or short-term toggle. Due: 2027-04-06. (owner: Keiko)
- AI-3: Rajiv to pick owner for runbook update and create the PR for runbook changes. Due: 2027-04-07. (owner: Rajiv)
- AI-4: Keiko + Rajiv to draft a canary rollout plan (bullet points) and circulate to SRE + Product. Due: 2027-04-08. (owner: Keiko / Rajiv)
- AI-5 (stretch): Rajiv to prepare a 5-min demo deck for Eng All Hands (voluntary). Due: 2027-04-20. (owner: Rajiv)

Notes-to-self during conversation (quick shorthand):
- If Rajiv seems hesitant to own visibility work, suggest a co-present with me for first demo.
- If infra timeline slips >1 week, push to schedule a rollback toggle and change the rollout target to next sprint.
- Keep coaching on stakeholder communication: ask him to CC product + SRE in the perf summary email.

Open questions / follow-ups to capture in doc after meeting:
- Exact perf dashboard URL and comparison baseline (prod vs staging 95/99p).
- Who on infra will be primary contact (name + Slack handle).
- Whether the postmortem action to update runbook has an assignee + PR link.

Useful links to paste in follow-up (if Rajiv asks):
- Perf dashboard (placeholder): https://perf.redwood.ai/dashboards/serving/kv-cache
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/782
- Infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-1245
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Oncall+Runbooks

Tone reminder to self: be empathetic (on-call fatigue), actionable (leave with 2 clear next steps), and growth-oriented (offer visibility opportunities).

End of prep. Will convert into meeting notes + update action items post-1:1.
